exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. 1 How many of the musketeers can you name? 2 Who's the man in the Iron Mask?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. 1 Mushketyorlardan nechtasining ismini aytа olasiz? 2 Temir niqobli odam kim?
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM HAQIDA: 'The Man in the Iron
  Mask' (1998) - Aleksandr Dyuma
  romani asosida. Fransiya qiroli
  Lyudovik XIV yovuz; uning egizak
  ukasi Phillippe qamoqda temir
  niqobda saqlanadi. To'rt
  mushketyor Phillippe'ni ozod
  qilib, qirol o'rniga qo'yadi.

  1 To'rt mushketyor: ATHOS,
    PORTHOS, ARAMIS, D'ARTAGNAN.
  2 Temir niqobli odam - PHILLIPPE,
    qirol Lyudovik XIV ning egizak
    ukasi.


⚠ 'A MUSKETEER':

  = mushketyor (qirol soqchisi).

tasks.prompt: Mushketyorlarning ismlari
tasks.answer: How many of the musketeers can you name?
tasks.speakAnswer: How many of the musketeers can you name?

tasks.speakAnswer: There are four musketeers: Athos, Porthos, Aramis and D'Artagnan.

tasks.speakAnswer: Who's the man in the Iron Mask?

tasks.answer: He is Phillippe, King Louis XIV's twin brother.
tasks.speakAnswer: He is Phillippe, King Louis XIV's twin brother.

exercises.explanationUz:
FILM FAKTLARI.

  1 King Louis XIV (14-Lyudovik)
  2 17TH CENTURY (1643-1715)
  3 Louis Raoul'ni urushga yuboradi,
    chunki CHRISTINE'ni sevadi
  4 Phillippe 6 yil qamoqda
  5 Egizaklar 22 yoshda
  6 MUSKETEERS - mushketyorlar


⚠ RIM RAQAMLARI:

  XIV = 14; XV = 15; XVI = 16.


⚠ 'TO BE KEPT IN PRISON':

  = qamoqda saqlanmoq (majhul).

MUShKETYORLAR ShIORI:

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the verb in brackets. "I 1) ___ (be) in this prison now for six years. I 2) ___ (wear) this mask since I came here. Before that, I 3) ___ (live) in a country house with an old woman and a priest. One day some men in black 4) ___ (come) to the house. They 5) ___ (bring) me to this prison and 6) ___ (put) me in a mask. Why? What 7) ___ (I/do)?"
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi fe'lning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring. (Phillippe'ning so'zlari: 'Men bu qamoqda olti yildan beri ... . Bu yerga kelganimdan beri bu niqobni ... . Undan oldin qishloq uyida kampir va ruhoniy bilan ... . Bir kuni qora kiyimli odamlar uyga ... . Ular meni bu qamoqqa ... va niqob ... . Nega? Men nima ...?')
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT (for/since) va
  PAST SIMPLE - 7-unit
  grammatikasi.

  1 have been ... FOR six years
    (hozirgacha davom etadi)
  2 have worn / have been wearing
    ... SINCE I came
  3 lived (before that - o'tgan)
  4 came (one day - o'tgan)
  5 brought
  6 put
  7 have I done? (nima qildim -
    natija hozir)


⚠ 'A PRIEST':

  = ruhoniy.


⚠ 'MEN IN BLACK':

  = qora kiyimli odamlar.

and ___ (put) me in a mask.
Why? What ___ (I/do)?
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ 'What have I done?' = men nima qildim (ki bunday jazo)?

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Name the characters and explain what is happening.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. Qahramonlarni ayting va nima bo'layotganini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'NG SURAT: qal'a devori oldida
  ikki kishi qilichbozlik qilyapti.
  Bu D'ARTAGNAN (yoki Athos) va
  PHILLIPPE - mushketyorlar
  Phillippe'ni qirol bo'lishga
  tayyorlash uchun qilichbozlikka
  o'rgatishyapti.


⚠ 'FENCING':

  = qilichbozlik.

exercises.instructionEn: Tick which of the following activities the musketeers train Phillippe to do: fencing, horseriding, cooking, dancing, driving, singing.
exercises.instructionUz: Mushketyorlar Fillipni quyidagi qaysi mashg'ulotlarga o'rgatishini belgilang: qilichbozlik, otda yurish, ovqat pishirish, raqs, haydash, kuylash.
exercises.explanationUz:
PHILLIPPE QIROL BO'LISh UChUN
  O'RGANADI:

  ✓ FENCING - qilichbozlik
  ✓ HORSERIDING - otda yurish
  ✓ DANCING - saroy raqslari
  ✗ cooking, driving, singing

  ⚠ 17-asrda 'driving' (mashina
  haydash) bo'lishi mumkin emas!

exercises.instructionEn: Mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM SIRLARI.

  1 T - D'Artagnan aslida
    egizaklarning otasi (qirolicha
    Anna bilan sirli sevgi)
  2 F - Louis egizagi borligidan
    xursand emas, uni qamoqqa
    qaytarmoqchi
  3 F - Film oxirida Phillippe qirol
    bo'ladi; Louis niqobda qamoqqa
    tushadi
  4 T - Phillippe (Louis XIV nomi
    bilan) buyuk qirol bo'ladi


⚠ 'A TWIN BROTHER':

  = egizak aka/uka.


⚠ 'TO GO ON TO BECOME':

  = keyinchalik ... bo'lmoq.

tasks.speak: D'Artagnan was Louis and Phillippe's father.

tasks.speak: Louis was happy to learn he had a twin brother.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the cues to write a paragraph about King Louis XIV of France: King of France (1643-1715); Louis born St. Germain-en-Laye, France, 1638; became king/aged 5; married Marie Therese, 1660; built palace at Versailles - took 27 years to build; ruled France 54 years - called 'Sun King' - known as France's greatest king; died Sept 1, 1715, age 73.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib Fransiya qiroli Lyudovik XIV haqida abzas yozing: Fransiya qiroli (1643-1715); 1638-yilda Sen-Jermen-an-Leda tug'ilgan; 5 yoshida qirol bo'lgan; 1660-yilda Mariya Terezaga uylangan; Versal saroyini qurgan - 27 yil qurilgan; Fransiyani 54 yil boshqargan - 'Quyosh qirol' deb atalgan - Fransiyaning eng buyuk qiroli sifatida tanilgan; 1715-yil 1-sentabrda 73 yoshida vafot etgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
TARJIMAI HOL YOZISh - 7-unit
  (Profiles) mavzusi.

  Tartib: tug'ilish → qirol bo'lish
  → oila → yutuqlar → vafot.
  Hamma fe'llar PAST SIMPLE:
  was born, became, married, built,
  ruled, was called, died.


⚠ 'TO RULE':

  = boshqarmoq, hukmronlik qilmoq.


⚠ 'THE SUN KING':

  = Quyosh qirol (Lyudovik XIV
  laqabi).

tasks.en: Louis XIV was King of France from 1643 to 1715. He was born in St. Germain-en-Laye, France, in 1638 and became king when he was only five years old.
tasks.uz: Lyudovik XIV 1643-yildan 1715-yilgacha Fransiya qiroli bo'lgan. U 1638-yilda Fransiyaning Sen-Jermen-an-Le shahrida tug'ilgan va atigi besh yoshida qirol bo'lgan.

tasks.en: In 1660 he married Marie Therese. He built the palace at Versailles, which took 27 years to build.
tasks.uz: 1660-yilda u Mariya Terezaga uylangan. U Versal saroyini qurgan - saroy 27 yil davomida qurilgan.

tasks.en: He ruled France for 54 years and was called the 'Sun King'. He is known as France's greatest king. Louis XIV died on September 1, 1715, at the age of 73.
tasks.uz: U Fransiyani 54 yil boshqargan va 'Quyosh qirol' deb atalgan. U Fransiyaning eng buyuk qiroli sifatida tanilgan. Lyudovik XIV 1715-yil 1-sentabrda 73 yoshida vafot etgan.

tasks.en: Louis XIV was King of France from 1643 to 1715. He was born in St. Germain-en-Laye, France, in 1638 and became king when he was only five years old. In 1660 he married Marie Therese. He built the palace at Versailles, which took 27 years to build. He ruled France for 54 years and was called the 'Sun King'. He is known as France's greatest king. Louis XIV died on September 1, 1715, at the age of 73.
tasks.uz: Lyudovik XIV 1643-yildan 1715-yilgacha Fransiya qiroli bo'lgan. U 1638-yilda Fransiyaning Sen-Jermen-an-Le shahrida tug'ilgan va atigi besh yoshida qirol bo'lgan. 1660-yilda u Mariya Terezaga uylangan. U Versal saroyini qurgan - saroy 27 yil davomida qurilgan. U Fransiyani 54 yil boshqargan va 'Quyosh qirol' deb atalgan. U Fransiyaning eng buyuk qiroli sifatida tanilgan. Lyudovik XIV 1715-yil 1-sentabrda 73 yoshida vafot etgan.

exercises.instructionEn: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Musketeers were bodyguards to the king and queen. Which famous person would you choose to be a bodyguard to, if you could? Why? 2 Would you like to have an identical twin? Why/Why not?
exercises.instructionUz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Mushketyorlar qirol va qirolichaning soqchilari edi. Imkoningiz bo'lsa, qaysi mashhur odamning soqchisi bo'lardingiz? Nega? 2 Bir xil egizagingiz bo'lishini xohlarmidingiz? Nega / nega yo'q?
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHOKAMA - 2-tur shart gap
  (would ... if ... could).

  1 'If I could, I would choose to
    be a bodyguard to ... because
    ...'
  2 'Yes, I would like to have an
    identical twin because we could
    share everything. / No, I
    wouldn't, because people would
    always confuse us.'


⚠ 'A BODYGUARD':

  = tansoqchi.


⚠ 'AN IDENTICAL TWIN':

  = bir xil (aynan o'xshash) egizak.

tasks.en: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Musketeers were bodyguards to the king and queen. Which famous person would you choose to be a bodyguard to, if you could? Why? 2 Would you like to have an identical twin? Why/Why not?
tasks.uz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Mushketyorlar qirol va qirolichaning soqchilari edi. Imkoningiz bo'lsa, qaysi mashhur odamning soqchisi bo'lardingiz? Nega? 2 Bir xil egizagingiz bo'lishini xohlarmidingiz? Nega / nega yo'q?

tasks.en: Which famous person would you choose to be a bodyguard to, if you could? Why?
tasks.uz: Imkoningiz bo'lsa, qaysi mashhur odamning soqchisi bo'lardingiz? Nega?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'If I could, I would be a bodyguard to a famous footballer, because I would travel to a lot of countries and watch every match.' (Imkonim bo'lsa, mashhur futbolchining soqchisi bo'lardim, chunki ko'p mamlakatlarga sayohat qilib, har bir o'yinni tomosha qilardim.)

tasks.en: Would you like to have an identical twin? Why/Why not?
tasks.uz: Bir xil egizagingiz bo'lishini xohlarmidingiz? Nega / nega yo'q?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'Yes, I would, because I would always have a best friend. / No, I wouldn't, because people would confuse us all the time.' (Ha, chunki doim eng yaqin do'stim bo'lardi. / Yo'q, chunki odamlar bizni doim adashtirardi.)

sentencePatterns.formula: I have been here for + MUDDAT / since + NUQTA
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have been in this prison for six years. I have worn this mask since I came here.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men bu qamoqda olti yildan beri. Bu yerga kelganimdan beri bu niqobni kiyaman.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + was born in + JOY + in + YIL. He became king at the age of ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Louis XIV was born in France in 1638 and became king when he was five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lyudovik XIV 1638-yilda Fransiyada tug'ilgan va besh yoshida qirol bo'lgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: If I could, I would + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I could, I would be a bodyguard to a famous singer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Imkonim bo'lsa, mashhur qo'shiqchining soqchisi bo'lardim.
